simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַחֲלָצָה (H4254) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מַחֲלָצָה (machălâtsâh) means a mantle (as easily drawn off ) First listed occurrence: Isa 3 22.

definitions.usage: changeable suit of apparel, change of raiment.
definitions.full: H4254. machalatsah [ מַחֲלָצָה ] noun feminine robe of state ( taken off in ordinary life); — only plural absolute מַחֲלָצוֺת Isa 3:22 robes of ladies of Jerusalem; Zech 3:4 of high priest.
